meta.purpose: Published answer keys for the real-world evaluation corpus. Every expectation is a statement made by the corpus project itself (inline comments, README, cheat sheet), quoted verbatim in citation.quote.
meta.derivation_rule: No entry was derived from running Checkov or any Emfirge rule. A resource the project states nothing about has no entry.
meta.citation_files_are_relative_to: the upstream repo at the commit in each project's SOURCE.json (README/cheat-sheet files are not vendored)

kind.misconfiguration: a single resource-level weakness the project states
kind.attack_path: an ordered chain the project documents (path_resources lists the Terraform resources on it)
kind.negative: a project statement that something is NOT reachable or NOT exposed

mapping.explicit: the project names the resource or the resource carries the project's own comment
mapping.inferred: the project describes the role/step in prose; mapping the prose to this Terraform resource is the corpus builder's reading

meta.caveat: present where the project's prose and its .tf disagree or where the .tf does not obviously show the stated condition
meta.run_assumptions: see backend/scripts/realworld_eval.py (provider 5.100.0 for TerraGoat/CloudGoat; cg_whitelist=203.0.113.10/32 where the scenario has no default)
